<?php
$x="old";$z="mid";$y="new";$n=0;
function ping(){echo "P;";}
function &f():string{global $x,$z,$y,$n;try{return $x;}finally{echo "O;";ping();try{return $z;}finally{echo "M;";ping();try{return $y;}finally{++$n;echo "I",$n,";";ping();if($n===1){$y=new stdClass;}else{$y="fixed";}}}}}
try{$r=&f();echo "rnull=",(int)($r===null),";";$r="changed";}catch(TypeError $e){echo "R;";}
echo "x=",$x,";z=",$z,";n=",$n,";yfixed=",(int)($y==="fixed"),";";

try{$r=&f();echo "rnull=",(int)($r===null),";";$r="changed";}catch(TypeError $e){echo "R;";}
echo "x=",$x,";z=",$z,";n=",$n,";yfixed=",(int)($y==="fixed"),";";
